title: Refining a new movement by practicing it upside down
title_zh: 倒立练习中对新运动的精细化
abstract: In this study, participants improved at copying an unfamiliar alphabet character even though they only practiced writing rotated versions of it. The experiments reveal that the motor system can refine movements by creating an abstraction of their structure, and not only by repeating the same mechanical muscle commands.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，参与者在仅练习旋转版本的情况下，仍提高了复写不熟悉字母字符的能力。实验揭示，运动系统可以通过构建其结构的抽象来精细化运动，而不仅仅是重复相同的机器肌肉指令。
